selection: All3200 fixed YCB heldout-scene validation queries from200 images and400 selected target instances. Exactly2 selected targets per frame; the other selected target is the counterfactual conditioner. No scores select pairs.
held_fixed: original frozen P3 and valid grid

arms.ORIGINAL: original context64, registered SAM box_grid, exact/radius2 selectedSAM logits
arms.CONTEXT_ONLY_SWAP: other selected target context64; original SAM and box_grid remain fixed. This deliberately inconsistent conditioning probe is not deployment accuracy.
arms.FULL_CONDITION_SWAP: other target context64 and same locked source SAM promptbox, rebuilt box_grid at original q/L, other-target selected full-resolutionSAM exact and native5x5 maximum sampled at original q/L

labels: Reconstruct other-target exact and native clipped5x5 visible/full support from official masks at the unchanged original q/L. Same six joint states and logical decoder as registered v64. Never relabel negatives.
evidence: Other-instance visible-mask union excludes the newly conditioned target; record external corroborated/ambiguous, strict5x5 full1vis0, near-boundary and overlapping-visible evidence. These remain source rendered/depth proxies, not certified human visibility.

SAM.prompts: same locked public source boxes, no mask/positive point prompts
SAM.selection: maximum SAM predicted quality, tie first
SAM.execution: set_image200 times and predict400 target prompts; decode once per target and resample for the other target's unchanged query8
SAM.replay_check: each decoded target's own original exact/radius2 grids must bitmatch v64 source_cache/YCB_VALIDATION_WITH_SAM.npz before saving counterfactual features
SAM.GPU: do not execute until parent explicitly releases GPU; CPU prepare and final head inference are allowed

metrics.thresholds: registered pVisible>=.5 else pFull>=.5; confidence diagnostic jointMAP only when maxjoint>=.5 elseU
metrics.ownership_changed_subset: separate exact V/E/O changed, exact visible-bit changed, full-bit changed; repeat at radius2
metrics.binary_correct_direction: (p_swapped-p_original)*(truth_other-truth_original)>0 on changed binary truth; ties separately
metrics.both_targets_correct: registered decoder correct for original target AND swapped target at the same original query; conditional on fixed changed-ownership subsets and all pairs
metrics.confidence_and_U: original/context/full U rates, paired coverage, both-target accuracy within jointly confident pairs; report jointMAP and registered logical decoder separately
metrics.strictE: descriptive slices for original/new target strict external5x5 and corroborated/ambiguous exact external, without label changes
metrics.rawSAM: visible-only exact/radius2 original-versus-full-swap baseline, no external/full inference from SAM foreground

box_provenance_caveat: Public YCB source box is annotation bbox_obj with fixed0.9..1.1 scale jitter. Swap reuses this same registered box, not a newly mask-fitted box. Source box is not GT-free; deployment needs its own available initial box.
